entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Takamaki-san, this is bad!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are these the lights?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What the...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Isn't this... "Sayuri"?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why are there so many of them?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have no idea...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Get out!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei, what is the meaning of this?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I suppose I can't keep quiet now that[n]you've seen this...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Truth be told... I'm in severe debt.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I handmade these "Sayuri" copies[n]and have been selling them through[n]a special connection of mine...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But why?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: The real "Sayuri"... was stolen by[n]one of my pupils long ago. I assume[n]they begrudged my strictness...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: That moment was quite a shock for me...[n]Since then, I've been mired in a terrible[n]artist's block...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Because of this distress, some of my[n]pupils handed their ideas over to me[n]from time to time...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I knew I couldn't keep that up, so[n]I attempted to recreate the "Sayuri"[n]a number of times.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: However, it resulted in nothing more[n]than replicas...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: That's when someone came to buy[n]the paintings, knowing well they[n]weren't original...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: ...It's all my fault. I couldn't pay the price[n]of being famous.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: As expectations for me rose, it reached[n]a point where I had no choice but to[n]keep making them...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I... needed money to further your[n]talents... I ask that you please forgive[n]your cowardly teacher...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please don't...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hold on... Something doesn't add up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If the original painting got stolen,[n]how did you make copies of it?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I... happened to find a finely detailed[n]photograph of it in an artbook.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So you managed to sell copies of[n]a photo of the original? I'm not sure[n]how this works, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't people who buy paintings[n]generally have a keen eye for[n]the fine arts?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This sounds like a lie to me.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: What would you know!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Something just doesn't feel right!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This one seems different!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: "Sayuri"?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This... This is the real "Sayuri"!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But you just said a moment ago[n]that it was stolen!

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: That's a replica!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No, it's nothing of the sort!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This painting kept me going...[n]It's the reason I made it this far...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sensei... Don't tell me...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: It's fake... Yes, a counterfeit! I heard[n]there was a counterfeit spreading[n]around, so I bought it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So you're telling me the actual artist[n]behind the painting bought a[n]counterfeit? That's pushing it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're lying, Sensei...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please just tell us the truth...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: You too?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I've reported you to my private security[n]company!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I had it set up to deal with some[n]problematic paparazzi, but I never[n]thought it'd come in so handy.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please, wait! Let's talk about this!

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: You can talk all you want to the police...[n]That includes you, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann, let's run!

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: A cat!? Where did it—

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: There's no point! They'll be here within[n]two minutes!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Takamaki-san!
